title: docs: error-handling.mdx says `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` is "not emitted today … do not write a client branch against it", but cloud's AI agent route emits it and objectui branches on it
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357) from the out-of-scope findings of the #17707 dev (report `5809956647` on #17158, class a). ⛔ Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The published text

`content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`, the `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` section (the seat read it on `origin/main` `f5a7250b7a`), says:
- "**Envelope:** none — no producer emits it";
- "**Not emitted today.** … no ObjectStack producer emits it. No response carries this code … — do not write a client branch against it."

The section was written under #17187 (closed), when no producer was known.

## The counter-fact

- **cloud:** the director's reading in `5807013768` on #17707, `origin/main` `b524051`, reads `packages/service-ai/src/routes/agent-routes.ts:572` returning `sendError(429, 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', …)` when a user's per-turn AI quota is spent. This seat cannot read cloud: the reading is the director's.
- **objectui:** at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `62597c5880`, `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts:314-321` branches on it (`error.details.resetAt`, `category: 'rate_limit'`), and its test pins that path.
- Ruling A on #17707 was narrowed on exactly this counter-fact: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` stays in `StandardErrorCode` (`5807013768`).

## Why it matters

A reader who follows the page drops a client branch that a live route needs, and it is precisely the branch objectui ships. The page tells readers not to write code the product depends on.

Seam: spec:`StandardErrorCode.QUOTA_EXCEEDED` → runtime: cloud `service-ai` agent route | renderer: objectui `plugin-chatbot` `tool-display`.

Dedupe words: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED not emitted today` · `error-handling.mdx QUOTA_EXCEEDED` · `QUOTA_EXCEEDED producer agent route docs`
